objects.random_heading.tooltip: Each object you put down gets a heading of its own, and so does each object of a pasted group. The heading field shows the next one. Trees and bushes look more natural this way.
inspector.randomize_headings.tooltip: Gives each selected object a new random heading, as one undo step. Positions stay as they are.
random.done: Gave {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} a new random heading. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
@random.done: {count} is how many objects were turned
